task: Prepare me for a meeting with Vercel (vercel.com)

merged.claim: Generic company description: Vercel positions itself as agentic infrastructure / the AI Cloud for building, deploying and running apps and agents.

variants.F: Vercel is agentic infrastructure for every app and agent — the platform where humans and AI agents build, ship, and scale software together (maker of v0, Next.js, and the AI Cloud).
variants.A: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next.
variants.D: Vercel is the AI Cloud, a unified platform for building, deploying, and scaling AI-powered applications and agentic workloads.
variants.E: Vercel is a platform where teams build and deploy their own apps and agents, with tools to build and run them in production securely and at scale.
variants.C: Vercel provides Agentic Infrastructure to ship apps and agents, enable coding agents to deploy software, and automate production investigations and fixes.
variants.B: Vercel describes itself as "Agentic Infrastructure": for coding agents to ship apps and agents automated by agents.

merged.claim: Guillermo Rauch, Founder & CEO, opened Ship 2026 with a vision of using production context to drive software improvement and autonomous agent action.

variants.A: Guillermo Rauch is Vercel's Founder and CEO; he opened Ship 2026 with a vision of agentic infrastructure in which production context drives software improvement and agents can build, deploy, and operate software.
variants.C: Guillermo Rauch, Founder and CEO of Vercel, emphasized in the October 15, 2026 Ship recap using production context to drive autonomous investigation, fixes, and continuous software improvement.

merged.claim: Guillermo Rauch is Founder & CEO; opened Ship 2026 (15 Oct 2026), said ~60% of platform activity is driven by coding agents, that the next chapter is long-running backend workloads, and signaled IPO readiness in April 2026.

variants.F: Guillermo Rauch is Vercel's Founder & CEO; he opened Ship 2026 (15 Oct 2026) with the agentic-infrastructure vision, said ~60% of platform activity is driven by coding agents and that Vercel's next chapter is long-running backend workloads, and signaled IPO readiness in April 2026.

merged.claim: Guillermo Rauch, Founder and CEO, discussed agent commerce with Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke in the 2026-10-16 announcement as Vercel Shop became GA.

variants.D: Guillermo Rauch is Vercel's Founder and CEO. In the 2026-10-16 announcement he discussed agent commerce with Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke as Vercel Shop became generally available.

merged.claim: Guillermo Rauch, Founder & CEO: at Ship 2026 said production context turns software into a loop, citing 28x growth in agent-triggered deployments; said in April 2026 Vercel is getting IPO-ready.

variants.B: Key person: Guillermo Rauch, Founder & CEO of Vercel. At Ship 2026 he said production context turns software into a loop, citing 28x growth in agent-triggered deployments; in April 2026 he said Vercel is getting IPO-ready.

merged.claim: Malte Ubl, CTO, announced Python GA and Vercel Daemons (continuously running background workers) at Ship 2026.

variants.A: Malte Ubl is Vercel's Chief Technology Officer; at Ship 2026 he announced Python generally available and Vercel Daemons for continuously running background workers.
variants.C: Malte Ubl, CTO of Vercel, announced Python general availability and introduced Vercel Daemons for continuously running background workers, per the October 15, 2026 Ship recap.

merged.claim: Malte Ubl, CTO: explained the Device Bound Session Credentials rollout (Chrome on Mac and Windows only for now) and DPoP work for the CLI in Nov 2026.

variants.B: Key person: Malte Ubl, CTO of Vercel. He explained the Device Bound Session Credentials rollout (Chrome on Mac and Windows only for now) and DPoP work for the CLI in Nov 2026.

merged.claim: Tomo Occhino, CPO: presented Agent Stack at Ship 2026; announced Vercel Drives GA, eve open-source agent framework, Vercel Connect GA with 1,000+ connectors, and Token Pass.

variants.F: Tomo Occhino is Vercel's CPO; at Ship 2026 he presented the Agent Stack and announced Vercel Drives (GA), the eve open-source agent framework, Vercel Connect GA with 1,000+ connectors, and Token Pass.

merged.claim: Jeanne (DeWitt) Grosser, COO, announced Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS GA and Enterprise-Managed Authorization for Vercel Connect in public beta at Ship 2026.

variants.A: Jeanne DeWitt Grosser is Vercel's Chief Operating Officer; at Ship 2026 she announced Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS generally available and enterprise-managed authorization for Vercel Connect in public beta.
variants.D: Jeanne Grosser is Vercel's Chief Operating Officer. At Ship 2026 she announced BYOC on AWS general availability and Enterprise-Managed Authorization for Vercel Connect in public beta.

merged.claim: Jeanne DeWitt Grosser, COO, joined in March 2025 and was interviewed by First Round Review (2026-02-05).

variants.B: Key person: Jeanne DeWitt Grosser, Chief Operating Officer of Vercel, joined in March 2025 and was interviewed by First Round Review (2026-02-05).

merged.claim: Nick Bogaty is Chief Revenue Officer (joined 13 Jan 2026 from Adobe; formerly CRO of AppDynamics, scaling $100M to $700M through Cisco acquisition); building an AI-forward GTM organization.

variants.F: Nick Bogaty is Vercel's Chief Revenue Officer (joined 13 Jan 2026 from Adobe; formerly CRO of AppDynamics, scaling $100M to $700M through the Cisco acquisition); he is building an AI-forward GTM organization to make Vercel the primary platform for the web and AI agents at the world's largest companies.

merged.claim: Talha Tariq, CTO of Security, joined October 2025 to lead security, covering Security Review and post-breach work.

variants.B: Key person: Talha Tariq, CTO of Security at Vercel, joined in October 2025 to lead security; his area covers Security Review and post-breach work.

merged.claim: Yury Selivanov, Director of Engineering, authored the Oct 15, 2026 announcement making Python a first-class runtime.

variants.C: Yury Selivanov, Director of Engineering at Vercel, authored the October 15, 2026 announcement making Python a first-class language and runtime on Vercel.

merged.claim: Tom Dale, Vercel engineering/product leader (title not stated), published the design for production-safe agents (investigate, permission-scoped plan, approval before higher-risk actions).

variants.E: Tom Dale, a Vercel engineering/product leader (title not stated), published Vercel's design for production-safe agents that investigate first, propose a permission-scoped plan, and request approval before higher-risk actions.

merged.claim: Bereket Engida, founder of Better Auth, joined Vercel with the team after acquisition, continuing open-source auth and agent-identity work for Connect and eve.

variants.A: Bereket Engida, founder of Better Auth, joined Vercel with the Better Auth team after Vercel's acquisition, continuing open-source authentication and agent-identity work for Connect and eve.

merged.claim: Priority: pivot to agentic infrastructure for coding agents as well as humans; developers 3x and agent-triggered deployments 28x in 12 months.

variants.F: Priority: Pivot to 'agentic infrastructure' for AI coding agents as well as human developers; in the last 12 months developers on Vercel grew 3x and agent-triggered deployments rose 28x.

merged.claim: Priority: three-part agentic strategy (build/deploy apps and agents, let coding agents deploy, automate Vercel itself with agents); agent-triggered deployments grew 28x.

variants.E: Priority: Vercel is making itself the platform for agentic infrastructure and agent-driven software delivery, with a three-part strategy: building and deploying apps and agents, enabling coding agents to deploy software, and automating Vercel itself with agents that use production context to investigate issues and surface pull requests. Agent-triggered deployments grew 28x in the prior 12 months.

merged.claim: Priority: be the platform where AI agents build, deploy and run software; Ship 2026 launch slate; Rauch cited developers 3x, new projects doubled, agent deployments 28x.

variants.B: Priority: Vercel is making itself the platform where AI agents build, deploy and run software. Ship 2026 launched Python GA, Vercel Daemons (public beta), Vercel Drives GA for Sandbox, persistent memory in the eve agent framework, Vercel Connect GA with 1,000+ connectors, and MCP Events (beta). Rauch said developer count rose 3x, new projects doubled and agent-triggered deployments rose 28x over 12 months.

merged.claim: Priority: build and commercialize agentic infrastructure for production workloads, including agent-operated deployment and production automation.

variants.A: Vercel priority: build and commercialize agentic infrastructure for production workloads; at Ship 2026 it framed its platform as infrastructure for building, deploying, and operating apps and agents, including agent-operated deployment and production automation.

merged.claim: Priority: infrastructure for production AI agents and full-stack apps; launched Vercel Schedules on 2026-11-04 (runtime create/change/cancel of scheduled work, Preview testing).

variants.C: Vercel priority: build infrastructure for production AI agents and full-stack applications; on 2026-11-04 it launched Vercel Schedules so applications and agents can create, change, and cancel scheduled work at runtime without redeploying, with testing in Preview environments.

merged.claim: Priority: expand beyond frontend into backend and long-running compute: Python GA, containers for custom runtimes, Daemons public beta.

variants.A: Vercel priority: expand beyond frontend hosting into backend and long-running compute, announcing Python generally available, containers for custom runtimes, and Daemons in public beta for continuously running background workers.

merged.claim: Priority: enterprise controls and deployment flexibility: Vercel for Enterprise, BYOC on AWS GA, Vercel Passport, Enterprise-Managed Authorization for Connect (public beta).

variants.F: Priority: Enterprise controls and deployment flexibility — Vercel for Enterprise, Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS GA (functions run in the customer's AWS account), Vercel Passport, and Enterprise-Managed Authorization for Vercel Connect (public beta).

merged.claim: Priority: customer-controlled infrastructure; BYOC on AWS GA 2026-10-15 for Enterprise, function execution inside customer AWS boundary while Vercel manages deployments, routing and static assets.

variants.C: Vercel priority: expand enterprise adoption through customer-controlled infrastructure; on 2026-10-15 it made Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS generally available for Enterprise customers, keeping function execution within customers' AWS security boundaries while Vercel manages deployments, routing, and static assets.

merged.claim: Priority: secure, governed agent access to external systems; Connect GA with short-lived scoped tokens; enterprise-managed authorization, token budgets, US-only inference, ZDR.

variants.A: Vercel priority: provide secure, governed agent access to external systems; Connect became generally available with short-lived scoped tokens, and Ship announcements added enterprise-managed authorization and controls such as token budgets, US-only inference, and zero data retention.

merged.claim: Priority: monetizing AI token usage via AI Gateway; Token Pass early access for Pro ($30/month for $80 credit for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3, Kimi K3), ZDR default, per-key budgets, US-only inference.

variants.F: Priority: Monetizing AI/agent token usage via the AI Gateway stack — Token Pass (early access for Pro teams, $30/month for $80 credit for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3), with ZDR on by default, per-key budgets and US-only inference.

merged.claim: Priority: AI Gateway as centrally governed multi-model control layer; Virtual Models change models, fallbacks, priority, ZDR centrally without redeploys; 125 new models from 10+ labs in 90 days.

variants.E: Priority: Vercel is building AI Gateway into a centrally governed, multi-model production control layer. Virtual Models let teams change models, fallbacks, priority and Zero Data Retention settings centrally without code changes or redeploys; 125 new models from more than 10 labs were added to AI Gateway in the prior 90 days.

merged.claim: Priority: AI Gateway as multi-model control layer; Ship added budgets, US-only inference, ZDR; Virtual Models Oct 28; Nov Production Index stats (decision models 26.1% of requests; Anthropic first choice for 42.7% of new teams vs 24.0% OpenAI).

variants.B: Priority: Vercel is growing AI Gateway as a multi-model control layer. Ship 2026 added spending budgets, US-only inference and Zero Data Retention; Virtual Models launched Oct 28. The November Production Index says decision models were 26.1% of Gateway requests in October and Anthropic is first-choice lab for 42.7% of new teams vs 24.0% for OpenAI.

merged.claim: Priority: grow AI app platform and model-access layer; headless v0 API; AI Gateway October index: open-weight models 71.5% of tokens and 23% of spend.

variants.A: Vercel priority: grow the AI application platform and model-access layer; it launched a headless v0 API for programmatic app generation, and AI Gateway production data showed open-weight models processed 71.5% of tokens and represented 23% of spend in the October index.

merged.claim: Priority: make persistent storage a core cloud primitive (Blob, Drives, future database and key-value), integrated across Functions, backends, Sandboxes, Daemons, meeting enterprise needs.

variants.A: Vercel priority: make persistent storage a core cloud primitive; a current Product Manager role owns Blob, Drives, and future database and key-value storage, integrating storage across Functions, backend services, Sandboxes, and Daemons and meeting enterprise durability, compliance, locality, and encryption needs.

merged.claim: Priority: persistent agent workloads; Vercel Drives GA 2026-10-15 so workspaces, memory, datasets and artifacts persist after a Sandbox stops and can be mounted by later runs.

variants.D: Vercel's priority is making agent workloads persistent across runs. Vercel Drives became generally available on 2026-10-15, so agent workspaces, file-based memory, datasets, and build artifacts persist after a Sandbox stops. Later runs and other Sandboxes can mount the same Drive.

merged.claim: Priority: infrastructure for agent-driven commerce; 2026-10-16 with Shopify, Vercel Shop and rebuilt Hydrogen SDK GA.

variants.D: Vercel is building infrastructure for agent-driven commerce. On 2026-10-16, with Shopify, it made Vercel Shop and the rebuilt Hydrogen SDK generally available. Vercel Shop is an open-source Next.js storefront template with machine-readable product information and tools for shopping agents.

merged.claim: Priority: strengthening Sandbox security and isolation (2026-10-14 report: researchers, AWS, Trail of Bits, structural hardening, kernel mitigation).

variants.D: Vercel is strengthening Sandbox security and isolation. Its 2026-10-14 report describes collaboration with researchers, AWS, and Trail of Bits, implementation of structural hardening recommendations, and work on kernel-vulnerability mitigation.

merged.claim: Priority: automating internal GTM and support with AI agents (COO Grosser, 2026-09-15 interview: inbound SDR automation, home-built support agent handling most cases).

variants.D: Vercel is automating internal go-to-market and support workflows with AI agents. In a 2026-09-15 interview report, COO Jeanne DeWitt Grosser described extensive inbound sales-development automation and a home-built support agent that handles most support cases.

merged.claim: Priority: scale enterprise GTM under new CRO Nick Bogaty, rebuilding Sales as 'the most AI-forward go-to-market organization', with heavy sales hiring.

variants.F: Priority: Scaling enterprise go-to-market under new CRO Nick Bogaty, rebuilding Sales as 'the most AI-forward go-to-market organization in the industry', with heavy sales hiring on the careers page.

merged.claim: Priority: pricing predictability for Pro customers; Flat Rate CDN introduced 2026-09-08 with predictable monthly billing and spike protection.

variants.C: Vercel priority: improve pricing predictability for Pro customers; on 2026-09-08 it introduced Flat Rate CDN with predictable monthly billing and traffic-spike protection, responding to customer feedback about unexpected CDN bills.

merged.claim: Priority: automate application security in the dev workflow; Security Review public beta launched 2026-11-02 (Vercel Agent scans pushes, reports, can validate and push fixes with permission).

variants.C: Vercel priority: automate application security within the development workflow; on 2026-11-02 it launched Security Review in public beta, where Vercel Agent scans repository pushes for vulnerabilities, reports findings, and can validate and push fixes with permission.

merged.claim: Priority: investing in platform and customer-code security: Security Review (public beta, Pro/Enterprise), Device Bound Session Credentials, DPoP coming to CLI.

variants.B: Priority: Vercel is investing in security for the platform and customers' code. Vercel Security Review (AI code scanner on every GitHub push) is in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams, Device Bound Session Credentials are rolling out to tie login sessions to devices, and CTO Malte Ubl says DPoP is coming to the CLI.

merged.claim: Priority: reduce latency and cost of delivering coding-agent changes; Vercel CI beta runs only affected tasks, right-sizes compute; internal push-to-CI-passed 2–6x faster after ~8M tasks.

variants.E: Priority: Vercel is working to reduce latency and cost of delivering coding-agent-generated changes. Vercel CI (beta) runs only tasks affected by a change and right-sizes compute; Vercel's internal time from git push to CI passed is 2–6x faster, after nearly 8 million tasks across its repositories and private beta.

merged.claim: Priority: developer workflow tools for agent-generated PR volume: Vercel CI (beta, all plans, ~8M tasks, 2-6x faster) and Vercel Schedules (public beta, Nov 4).

variants.B: Priority: Vercel is building developer workflow tools for high volumes of agent-generated pull requests. Vercel CI (beta on all plans) runs only affected tasks; Vercel says it got its own push-to-green 2-6x faster, with almost 8M tasks run. Vercel Schedules (public beta, Nov 4) lets agents and apps create recurring or one-time tasks at runtime without redeploying.

merged.claim: Priority: preparing for an IPO while revenue grows; Rauch 'getting more ready for it every day', 'I think next year'; Forbes run rate $340M end Feb 2026 vs $100M start of 2024.

variants.B: Priority: Vercel is preparing for an IPO while revenue grows fast. Rauch said Vercel is "getting more ready for it every day" with no exact timing, and in a separate interview said "I think next year". Forbes put revenue run rate at $340M at end of Feb 2026, up from $100M at start of 2024.

merged.claim: Challenge: Sandbox isolation as agents run untrusted code; public challenge: 1,285 reports, $242,000 bounties, Linux kernel zero-day; no customer-data access shown.

variants.A: Vercel's public Sandbox challenge generated 1,285 reports, paid $242,000 in bounties, and uncovered a Linux kernel zero-day that could leak host memory, crash the host, or execute code on it; Vercel said no report showed customer-data access. Challenge: maintaining sandbox isolation and security as agents run hostile or untrusted code.

merged.claim: Challenge: hardening Sandbox against kernel-level vulnerabilities; 2026-10-14 report disclosed a kernel flaw (demonstrated on researcher machines), coordinated mitigation with AWS, CVEs pending, no customer-data access; not evidence of production breach.

variants.D: Challenge: hardening Sandbox isolation against kernel-level vulnerabilities. Vercel's 2026-10-14 report disclosed a Linux-kernel flaw that can break sandbox isolation, demonstrated on researcher-controlled machines matching Vercel Sandbox's configuration. Mitigation was coordinated with the researcher and AWS, and fixes were under private review with CVEs pending. No reports showed access to customer data. This is not evidence of a production breach or of an unresolved issue today.

merged.claim: Challenge: pricing predictability and bill shock; unbounded usage bills, Spend Management off by default and not a true ceiling; Riley Walz $46,485.99 charge (Feb 2026); $0.15/GB egress vs Cloudflare's none.

variants.F: Challenge: Vercel faces pricing predictability and bill-shock issues — usage bills are unbounded, Spend Management is off by default and not a true ceiling, and runaway bills keep surfacing (e.g., developer Riley Walz's $46,485.99 on-demand charges in Feb 2026, with CEO Guillermo Rauch offering to pay it; Vercel charges $0.15/GB egress vs Cloudflare's none).

merged.claim: Challenge: customer feedback that traffic bursts, viral launches and misconfigured routes cause unexpected CDN bills, prompting Flat Rate CDN.

variants.A: Vercel challenge: customers continued to give feedback that traffic bursts, viral launches, and misconfigured routes could create unexpected CDN bills (unpredictable CDN costs), prompting Flat Rate CDN.

merged.claim: Challenge: billing clarity and support escalation for automated Agent usage; 2026-09-07 customer complaint, refunded per Vercel's 2026-09-24 reply (individual case).

variants.D: Challenge: billing clarity and timely support escalation for automated Agent usage. On 2026-09-07 a customer alleged unexpected automatic Vercel Agent charges, an unanswered billing case, and disabled production deployments. Vercel replied on 2026-09-24 that support had issued a refund the previous week. This is an individual, refunded complaint, not evidence of a platform-wide or unresolved problem.

merged.claim: Challenge: competitive pressure from Cloudflare (free egress, Workers) and Netlify (dropped per-seat pricing April 2026), plus OpenNext and Cloudflare's Next.js support eroding lock-in.

variants.F: Challenge: Vercel faces competitive pressure from Cloudflare (free egress, Workers) and Netlify (dropped per-seat pricing in April 2026), plus OpenNext and Cloudflare's Next.js support eroding the Next.js lock-in that underpins Vercel's premium.

merged.claim: Challenge: competition from Cloudflare and AWS in hosting, and a weak software IPO market frozen by AI-disruption sell-off.

variants.B: Challenge: Vercel faces competition from Cloudflare and AWS in hosting, and a weak software IPO market where a sell-off driven by AI disruption fears has largely frozen the IPO pipeline.

merged.claim: Challenge: per-seat price pressure; comparison site says 5-person team pays $20/month on Netlify vs $100/month on Vercel Pro; Cloudflare $5 plan has no egress charges.

variants.B: Challenge: Vercel faces price pressure on per-seat pricing. A third-party comparison site (undated, after April 2026) says Netlify moved to flat pricing so a 5-person team pays $20/month on Netlify vs $100/month on Vercel Pro, and Cloudflare's $5 plan has no bandwidth or egress charges.

merged.claim: Challenge: reliability under burst traffic; ticketing launch (~3M requests first hour) caused ~5 min Vercel outage, ~$200 unintended Edge Function charges, agency Strum moved CDN to Cloudflare (13 Aug 2026).

variants.F: Challenge: Reliability under burst traffic — during a ticketing launch (~3M requests in the first hour) Vercel went down for about five minutes while the Railway backend stayed up, ~$200 was billed for unintended Edge Function invocations, and the long-time agency customer (Strum) moved frontend CDN to Cloudflare (13 Aug 2026).

merged.claim: Challenge: internal culture strain from AI-first restructuring; lead agent replaced nine of ten SDRs; Glassdoor Apr 2026 4.1/5 overall, 3.6/5 work-life and senior management; no mass layoff.

variants.F: Challenge: Vercel has internal culture strain from AI-first restructuring — its lead agent replaced nine of ten SDRs in early 2025; Glassdoor (Apr 2026) shows 4.1/5 overall but 3.6/5 work-life balance and senior management, with reviews citing overwork, reorgs and uncertainty (no mass layoff).

merged.claim: Challenge: supporting enterprise requirements (scale, compliance, data locality, encryption) while broadening the platform; storage trade-offs in performance, availability, durability, speed, cost.

variants.A: Vercel challenge: supporting enterprise adoption requirements (scale, compliance, data locality, encryption) while broadening the platform, alongside performance, availability, durability, speed, and cost trade-offs in storage, per its storage product brief.

merged.claim: Challenge: enterprises want more employees building with AI without losing security, access, data and spend control; building easier but governance harder; unapproved AI or badly built login pages can expose data.

variants.E: Challenge: Enterprises need to let more employees build with AI without losing security, access, data and spending control. Vercel says building has become easier while governance has become harder, and warns that unapproved AI use or an incorrectly built login page can expose private data publicly.

merged.claim: Challenge: long-lived static credentials and fragmented machine-to-machine auth; thousands of engineering hours on key rotations; only 8.4% of 1,000+ SaaS vendors supported secure auth methods.

variants.E: Challenge: Long-lived static credentials and fragmented machine-to-machine authentication create security and operational risk. Vercel says they can leak via repositories, chat, compromised services or prompt injection; it spent thousands of engineering hours on key rotations and found only 8.4% of 1,000+ surveyed SaaS vendors supported secure authentication methods.

merged.claim: Challenge: coding-agent pull requests strain conventional CI that reruns the whole workflow each push; Vercel CI beta addresses it.

variants.E: Challenge: The rise in coding-agent pull requests strains conventional CI, which reruns the entire workflow on every push and leaves developers waiting; Vercel launched Vercel CI in beta to address this.

merged.claim: Challenge: CI throughput needed to keep up with coding agents; agent PRs were waiting on CI; Vercel says its own CI now keeps up.

variants.C: Vercel challenge: CI throughput needed to keep up with coding agents; agent-generated pull requests were waiting on CI, and Vercel says its own CI now keeps up with its agents.

merged.claim: Challenge: third-party AI-tool security exposure; Context.ai compromise pivoted into Vercel to decrypt non-sensitive env variables; customers notified; incident closed per Oct 16, 2026 update.

variants.C: Vercel challenge: third-party AI-tool security exposure. An attacker compromised Context.ai, accessed an employee's accounts, and pivoted into Vercel systems to decrypt environment variables not marked sensitive; Vercel notified affected customers and shipped safeguards. The October 16, 2026 update says remediation is complete and the incident is closed.

merged.claim: Challenge: customers face very fast AI model turnover (over half of October requests to models <60 days old; ~6-week half-life); Anthropic's Gateway spend share fell from 69.2% (Dec 2025) to 32.2% (Oct 2026).

variants.B: Challenge: Vercel's customers face very fast AI model turnover. Over half of October's language-model requests went to models under 60 days old (model half-life about 6 weeks), and Anthropic's share of Gateway spend fell from 69.2% in Dec 2025 to 32.2% in Oct 2026.

merged.claim: Recent: Security Review public beta launched 3 Nov 2026 (automated security review).

variants.F: Recent change: Vercel launched Security Review in public beta (3 Nov 2026), an automated security review capability on the platform.

merged.claim: Recent: Vercel Tracing became GA (6 Nov 2026), part of observability for apps and agents.

variants.F: Recent change: Vercel Tracing became generally available (6 Nov 2026), part of the observability story for apps and agents in production.

merged.claim: Recent: Ship SF (15 Oct 2026, 2,700+ attendees) launch slate: Daemons beta, Drives GA, eve, Connect GA 1,000+ connectors, MCP Events beta, Token Pass early access, BYOC on AWS GA, Python GA.

variants.F: Recent change: At Ship SF (15 Oct 2026, 2,700+ attendees) Vercel launched its agentic infrastructure slate: Vercel Daemons (public beta), Vercel Drives (GA), eve agent framework, Vercel Connect GA with 1,000+ connectors, MCP Events beta, Token Pass early access, Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS GA, and Python GA.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-10-15): Ship 2026 expanded platform for agents/backends: Python GA, Drives GA, Daemons beta, AI Gateway governance, BYOC on AWS GA.

variants.A: On 2026-10-15 Vercel Ship 2026 expanded the platform for agents and backends: generally available Python and Vercel Drives, public-beta Daemons, AI Gateway governance controls, and Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS generally available.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-10-15): Ship 2026 drew 10,000+ attendees across five cities; launches incl. BYOC on AWS GA, Passport beta, AI SDK 7, Python GA, Daemons, Drives, Connect GA.

variants.B: Recent event (2026-10-15): Vercel Ship 2026 drew 10,000+ attendees across five cities, with launches including Bring Your Own Cloud on AWS GA, Passport beta and AI SDK 7 alongside Python GA, Daemons, Drives and Connect GA.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-10-15): Python made a first-class runtime (GA) with native support for APIs, full-stack apps, agents and shared frontend/backend workflows.

variants.C: Recent change (2026-10-15): Vercel made Python a first-class runtime (generally available), with native support for APIs, full-stack applications, and agents and shared frontend/backend deployment workflows.

merged.claim: Recent: Amit Agarwal (ex-Datadog President) appointed to board (5-6 Aug 2026), after $500M annualized run-rate in July 2026 (~$600M by Oct reported, unconfirmed).

variants.F: Recent change: Vercel appointed Amit Agarwal (ex-Datadog President, CEO of Standard Template Labs) to its board (5-6 Aug 2026), after disclosing it crossed $500M annualized run-rate revenue in July 2026 (a reported ~$600M by October 2026 is unconfirmed by Vercel).

merged.claim: Recent (2026-08-19): Vercel for Slack public beta; Vercel Agent investigates incidents, answers infra questions, reviews PRs, proposes approved changes for Pro and Enterprise.

variants.A: On 2026-08-19 Vercel for Slack entered public beta: Vercel Agent can investigate incidents, answer infrastructure questions, review pull requests, and propose approved changes from Slack for Pro and Enterprise teams.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-08-25): Vercel Connect GA, replacing long-lived provider tokens with short-lived scoped runtime credentials; 100+ services.

variants.A: On 2026-08-25 Vercel Connect became generally available, replacing long-lived provider tokens with short-lived, scoped runtime credentials for agents and supporting 100+ services.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-10-28): Virtual Models on AI Gateway: stable virtual model ID with underlying model, fallbacks, config and ZDR changed centrally without redeploys.

variants.E: Recent change (2026-10-28): Vercel launched Virtual Models on AI Gateway, giving teams a stable virtual model ID while the underlying model, fallbacks, configuration and Zero Data Retention settings are changed centrally without code changes or redeploys.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-10-16): Vercel reported all remediation for the April security incident complete and closed the incident.

variants.C: Recent change (2026-10-16): Vercel reported all remediation actions for the April security incident were complete and closed the incident.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-11-04): Vercel Schedules public beta lets apps and agents create one-time/recurring tasks at runtime via SDK, CLI or API without redeploying; built on Queues.

variants.B: Recent launch (2026-11-04): Vercel Schedules (public beta) lets apps and agents create one-time and recurring tasks at runtime via SDK, CLI or API without redeploying; built on Queues.

merged.claim: Recent (2026-11-09): AI Gateway Production Index for November 2026: decision models 26% of requests, new teams pick Anthropic first ~2:1 over OpenAI, Opus 5.5 top model by spend.
